name: reservoir-log
prompt: At a small research station, three sealed reservoirs feed a laboratory sink. The blue reservoir holds rainwater, the green reservoir holds filtered well water, and the gray reservoir is reserved for cleaning equipment. Each container has a separate meter. On Tuesday morning the blue meter read 120 liters and the green meter read 90 liters. By evening the blue meter had fallen to 75 liters and the green meter to 60 liters. A technician filled an empty sample bottle from the blue reservoir at noon, then poured the unused portion back into the same reservoir before the evening reading. That temporary transfer was not an additional source of water. The gray reservoir was never connected to the laboratory sink that day. A handwritten note claimed the sink used 80 liters from the blue and green reservoirs combined, but the technician wanted the calculation checked against the meter readings. State the combined net decrease and explain which measurements are relevant. Do not count the returned sample twice or include the gray reservoir.
